```{r}
%md
# BASIC INFORMATION
This script calculates lengths of consecutive dry days for daily ERA5 data and daily NEX-GDDP CMIP6 future and historic precipitation data.

Inputs: 
- ERA5 daily data in tabular format (from notebook 00_ERA5_DailyData_GoldTable); 
- NEX_GDDP CMIP6 daily precipitation data in tabular format (from notebook 00_CMIP_GoldTable_Query )

Outputs: 
- count = RUN LENGTH, freq_xxx = NUMBER OF TIMES RUN LENGTH OCCURS
- ERA5 CDD Table (cdd_era5); 
<br>-- x, y, year, count, freq_era5
- CMIP6 CDD table (cdd_cmip_future); 
<br>-- x, y, model, ssp, year,count, freq_fut
- CMIP6 CDD table (cdd_cmip_hist)
<br>--x, y, model, year, count, freq_hist
- NOTE: COUNT = Specific run length, FREQ_TIME = Number of times the specific run length occured

**Last Updated: February 3, 2025**
```


```{r}
%md
# Notebook Setup
```


```{r}
# install & load packages
install.packages('dplyr')
install.packages('sparklyr')
library(sparklyr)
library(dbplyr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Create a spark connection
sc <- spark_connect(method = 'databricks')
```


```{r}
%md
## DEFINE VARIABLES
```


```{r}
## SET VARIABLES FOR SCRIPT
roi = "XX"
project.number = "YYY"
count_length = ZZ #for example, 7 if interested in dry streaks of a week or longer
```


```{r}
%md
# CMIP FUTURE
```


```{r}
# Pull in CMIP precipitation data
dd_cmip <- tbl(sc, in_catalog("projects", paste(project.number, roi, sep = "_"), paste(roi, "cmip_future", sep = "_")))
```


```{r}
# Create month & year columns
# Categorize days as dry days (<=1mm precip)
dd_cmip <- dd_cmip %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dry_day = ifelse(precip <=1, 1, 0))

# Create grouping variable for cdd calculation
dd_cmip <- dd_cmip %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group_var = paste(x, y, year, model, ssp, sep = "_"))
```


```{r}
# Calculate dry day run lengths
out <- dd_cmip%>%
  dplyr::group_by(x, y, model, ssp) %>% # group by grid cell and model
  window_order(x, y, model, ssp, time) %>% # order by grid cell, model, and time
  mutate(change = (group_var != lag(group_var, default = first(group_var)) |
                     dry_day != lag(dry_day, default = first(dry_day)))) %>% #TRUE/FALSE VALUE FOR IF ROW IS WITHIN THE GROUP VARIABLE AND OVER TEMP THRESH
  mutate(change = as.numeric(change)) %>% # Go from T/F to 1/0
  group_by(run = cumsum(change), group_var) %>% #Count the run length 
  summarise(count = n(), # pull count
         dry_day = first_value(dry_day), # pull 0/1 for dry day
         x = first_value(x), # pull x value
         y = first_value(y), # pull y vaule
         model = first_value(model), # pull model names
         year = first_value(year), # pull year
         ssp = first_value(ssp), # pull ssp
         .groups = 'drop') %>% 
  filter(dry_day == 1, count >= count_length) %>% # get values that are dry days with runs of count length or longer
  group_by(x, y, model, year, ssp, count) %>% 
  summarise(freq_fut = n(), .groups = 'drop') #get the frequency of different run lengths for each grid cell, model, and year
```


```{r}
# save table
table.name = paste("projects.", project.number, "_", roi, ".cdd_cmip_future", sep = "")

spark_write_table(out, 
                 name = table.name,
                 mode = "overwrite")
```


```{r}
rm(out, dd_cmip)
```

```{r}
%md
# CMIP HISTORICAL
```


```{r}
# Pull in historic CMIP precipitation data
dd_cmip_hist <- tbl(sc, in_catalog("projects", paste(project.number, roi, sep = "_"), paste(roi,"cmip_historical", sep = "_")))
```


```{r}
# Create month & year columns
# categorize days as dry days
dd_cmip_hist <- dd_cmip_hist %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dry_day = ifelse(precip <=1, 1, 0))
# Create grouping variable for cdd calculations
dd_cmip_hist <- dd_cmip_hist %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group_var = paste(x, y, year, model, sep = "_"))
```


```{r}
# Calculate dry day run lengths
out <- dd_cmip_hist %>%
  dplyr::group_by(x, y, model) %>% # group by grid cell and model
  window_order(x, y, model, time) %>% # order by grid cell, model, and time
  mutate(change = (group_var != lag(group_var, default = first(group_var)) |
                     dry_day != lag(dry_day, default = first(dry_day)))) %>% #TRUE/FALSE VALUE FOR IF ROW IS WITHIN THE GROUP VARIABLE AND OVER TEMP THRESH
  mutate(change = as.numeric(change)) %>% # Go from T/F to 1/0
  group_by(run = cumsum(change), group_var) %>% #Count the run length 
  summarise(count = n(), # pull count
         dry_day = first_value(dry_day), # pull 0/1 for dry day
         x = first_value(x), # pull x value
         y = first_value(y), # pull y vaule
         model = first_value(model), # pull model names
         year = first_value(year), # pull year
         .groups = 'drop') %>% 
  filter(dry_day == 1, count >= count_length) %>% # get values that are dry days with runs of count length or longer
  group_by(x, y, model, year, count) %>% 
  summarise(freq_hist = n(), .groups = 'drop') #get the frequency of different run lengths for each grid cell, model, and year
```


```{r}
# Save output
table.name = paste("projects.", project.number, "_", roi, ".cdd_cmip_hist", sep = "")
spark_write_table(out, 
                 name = table.name,
                 mode = "overwrite")
```


```{r}
%md
# ERA5
```


```{r}
# Pull in daily ERA5 daya
dd_era5 <- tbl(sc, in_catalog("projects", paste(project.number, roi, sep = "_"), paste(roi,"dailysummary", sep = "_")))
```


```{r}
# Create month and & columns 
# Categorize days as dry days
dd_era5 <- dd_era5 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dry_day = ifelse(precip <=1, 1, 0))

dd_era5 <- dd_era5 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group_var = paste(x, y, year, sep = "_"))
```


```{r}
# Calculate dry day runs
out <- dd_era5 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(x, y) %>%
  window_order(x, y, time) %>%
  mutate(change = (group_var != lag(group_var, default = first(group_var)) |
                     dry_day != lag(dry_day, default = first(dry_day)))) %>%
  mutate(change = as.numeric(change)) %>%
  group_by(run = cumsum(change), group_var) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), 
         dry_day = first_value(dry_day),
         x = first_value(x),
         y = first_value(y),
         year = first_value(year),
         .groups = 'drop') %>%
  filter(dry_day == 1, count >= count_length) %>%
  group_by(x, y, year, count) %>%
  summarise(freq_era5 = n(), .groups = 'drop')
```


```{r}
# Save output
table.name = paste("projects.", project.number, "_", roi, ".cdd_era5", sep = "")
spark_write_table(out, 
                 name = table.name,
                 mode = "overwrite")
```
